description: Displays a user persona card with avatar, demographics, quote, and slotted sections for background, goals, frustrations, and behaviors

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Persona name, used when there is no slot="name" child (the slot wins). Drives the avatar initials and color.

attributes.name: job-title
attributes.description: Job title (e.g. "Product Manager"), shown under the name. Linked <user-story persona-id> cards use it for their "As a…" text. Reflects the jobTitle property.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Deprecated (0.2.x name for job-title; it also gave the element an invalid ARIA role). On upgrade, a value that is not a valid ARIA role is moved to job-title (unless job-title is set) and the role attribute is removed, with one console warning per page. A valid ARIA role is left alone. Will be ignored in 0.4.0.

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: Location, shown with a pin icon

attributes.name: avatar
attributes.description: Avatar image URL (http(s), relative, or data:image). When omitted, initials are generated from the name.

attributes.name: quote
attributes.description: Key quote, used when there is no slot="quote" child (the slot wins)

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of a JSON persona record. Fetched once per value; the record sets job-title (from jobTitle, or the legacy role key), age, location and avatar, and creates (or replaces) the name, quote, bio, goals, frustrations and behaviors slotted children.

attributes.name: data-list-stories
attributes.description: Render a Stories section that auto-lists every <user-story persona-id="…"> matching this persona's id. Updates live when stories are added, removed, or relabeled.

attributes.name: data-mock
attributes.description: Fill any missing name, job title, age, location, avatar, quote, goals, frustrations and behaviors with deterministic sample data (seeded by data-seed or the data-mock value).

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Observed: the id that <user-story persona-id> matches. Changing it re-renders the Stories section.

slots.name: name
slots.description: Persona name (e.g. <h2>). Defaults to the name attribute, then "Unnamed Persona".

slots.name: quote
slots.description:
Key quote (e.g.

). Defaults to the quote attribute.

slots.name: goals
slots.description: List of what the persona wants to achieve

slots.name: frustrations
slots.description: List of pain points and blockers

slots.name: behaviors
slots.description: List of observable patterns and habits

events.name: user-persona:ready
events.description: Once per element, after the first render. With src, after the fetched data renders (not fired if the fetch fails). Not re-fired by attribute changes or moves. detail.role is a deprecated copy of jobTitle. For the 0.3.x line the deprecated un-namespaced alias persona-ready is dispatched right after, with the same detail.

events.name: user-persona:upgraded
events.description: Once, in a microtask after first connect. Wait for this before assigning .data from a framework.
